author: Raiylu
body:
My Name is Raiylu, I am 14, live in New Zealand and I have a youtube channel where I do Minecraft PVP and Graphics

This is my situation: 

It was my birthday December 30th 2014 and I had a friend over for a few weeks as I don't see him often. We were playing Nebula as usual and i was banned for auto clicking. This came as a shock but also I understood because I have been called on autoclikcing a lot on many different servers. 

I come from a pvp community, MCPVP (Closed now) and it is all about soupPVP there. As the pvp style evolved it became that you would have to be very fast clicking to win any fight (Youtube search: MCPVP Clicking fast). I came up with a technique that no one thought of and that worked extremely well, so well I even made a video about it which you can see here : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZWgcMQDBfBo
I didn't explain it very well in the video but the idea is that if you slide your finger down your mouse click with a certain amount of pressure your finger vibrates and clicks the mouse rather quickly, I explained in the video that it doesnt work when attacking one player because I thought minecraft had a click cap but I later learned that if you don't focus on a particular player and combine this click with just throwing your mouse at everyone you can bypass the click cap. 

I realized I evaded ban but it was simply to bring attention to the mod that he had done wrong, I was rather mad because i was having fun. I really enjoy avicus in fact I even applied for MOD some months before the ban. Anyway, I hope ive been reasonable and have exolained the situation well.
Please consider my appeal
regards
- Raiylu

replies.body:
Hello,

Since you have spent many months banned, I have decided to appeal your ban. However, if you are banned for hacking once again, your chances of being appealed will be extremely low. Be sure to read the rules and welcome back!

Regards,

GalaxyBrit
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
